findings.text: The 38-file gate omits test files that import a moved symbol from the graph_ops facade and therefore exercise the new forwarders at runtime: this file imports write_reviews from graph_ops but is not in gate-logs/targets.txt, and an independent name scan finds 41 such files absent from the gate list (including test_property_coverage_helper.py:49, which asserts graph_ops.property_coverage exists). The patch-target criterion the brief states does not cover them, so the forwarder's services injection is exercised at runtime by only part of its callers.

The boundary paragraph states the new module 'imports graph_foundation and no other graph storage module', but graph_catalog.py imports no graph storage module at all: it has no graph_foundation import and takes GraphClient, GraphSchema and retry_on_deadlock directly from imas_codex.graph.client, imas_codex.graph.schema and imas_codex.discovery.base.claims, matching the sibling storage modules.
